export interface PicodashDevBridgeHostOptions {
  readonly origin: string;
  readonly command: Readonly<{
    file: string;
    args: readonly string[];
    cwd: string;
  }>;
  readonly credentialDirectory?: string;
  readonly browserCredentialEnv?: string;
  readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
  /** Optional explicit maximum session duration; normal lifetime follows its owner. */
  readonly lifetimeMs?: number;
}
export type PicodashDevBridgeHostStatus = 'idle' | 'starting' | 'running' | 'stopping' | 'stopped' | 'failed';
export declare function createPicodashDevBridgeHost(options: PicodashDevBridgeHostOptions): {
  start: () => Promise<Readonly<{
    credentialPath: string;
    origin: string;
    childPid: number;
  }>>;
  stop: () => Promise<void>;
  finished: Promise<Readonly<{
    code: number;
    signal: NodeJS.Signals | null;
  }>>;
  readonly status: PicodashDevBridgeHostStatus;
};
